args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation plans, here is the recommended packing list:

- Swimwear (2-3 suits)
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- Hiking gear (hiking boots, poles, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight pants, shirts, dress for Pearl Harbor visit)
- Camera (for Diamond Head and cultural center)
- Travel documents (passport, ID, health insurance card)
- Comfortable shoes (for beach and hiking)
- Power adapter (for phone charging)
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Luau attire (light dress or aloha shirt)
- Travel-size essentials (toiletries, medications)
- Light jacket (for evening at North Shore)
- Cash and credit cards
